author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here :3

So, as I hope you may know, I hate unfairness, even if it benefits me. With this in-mind, I was thinking of how us donors get extra XP. Like, people with way more skill and the same amount of game-time than me have the same amount of XP. I just really hate how unfair it is. With my prestige, I want to show people how experienced and good/bad I am at the game; not just how much money I can pay to look better. I'm sure that there are people that have more skill and put in more effort but are still more unrecognized than us donors. I honestly hope this doesn't offend any donors. A lot of you are very good and do put a lot of effort into the prestige; if this offends you in any way, tell me on Skype and I'll delete this ASAP. But really, I just want to show a true, honest picture of how experienced I am with Nebula and not just a distorted image to make me look better than I really am. I would love to compare my skill with people without having any unfair advantages and for everything to be equal and fair. I don't want to look any better than I really am. So, without further ado, I would like to explain how I would intend this to work. What you would do is if you're a donor, you would type "/toggle xp". This would bring you back to how much XP you would have if you didn't get a multiplier. Say you donated to get Gold. Then, you would get your current amount of XP divided by 1.5 regardless of prestiges (If you prestiged once and got 10 extra levels, you would go back a prestige and go to level 40 (60/1.5=40)) Of course, this will all be optional, so if donors don't want to do this, they don't have to. If you have any ideas, approval, or criticism, please comment below!
